pre_relocation_reference.meaning: Historical top before moving image processing after DDR. These hashes and latency do not describe the relocated production top.

test_scope: Actual SFP decode and vendor FIFO with a local one-clock RGB565 expansion/input-register mirror. The production top, DDR restoration, image core, HDMI and PCIe output are not instantiated in this test.
local_mirror_rgb565_expansion: Old SFP top bit replication, for old/new FIFO timing comparison only. Relocated production DDR path uses zero-filled RGB565 expansion and is checked separately.
vendor_model_version: PDS_2022.2-SP6.4 GTP_DRM18K + FIFO v1.9 / control v1.4

full.warning_origin: Common unmodified vendor sdpram: unused WWCONF output and inactive address-width branches; warnings occur for both old and new elaborations.

checks: Actual generated FIFO and vendor DRM/Gray-pointer CDC model, not an ideal queue
All transmitted RGB565 pixels and low/high 16-bit word order
New data / effective DE / VS equal original outputs delayed exactly one clock
Every raster read enable and prefill startup boundary unchanged
Vendor read-water-level / empty flags identical outside matched reset blanking
Each complete row 1920 DE clocks; row-start period 2200 clocks; full frame 1080 rows
First and last pixels preserved, no remaining FIFO frame payload
Mid-line frame marker safely flushes and rearms both readers
Local test mirror RGB565 expansion / RGB888 / VS / DE register retains exactly one clock; this is not the relocated production top
Original internal frame-reset and RX packet timing preserved
PDS already lists all three required IPML source modules; no SFP hierarchy constraints found, hierarchy names retained
limit: Vendor functional simulation verifies SFP FIFO/CDC protocol and decode timing only. Local entry mirror is not the relocated production top or image core. DDR restoration is verified separately. Physical routed setup/recovery/hold require the new PDS STA report.
